ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Mazu places nurturing the sacred embryo beside wearing clothes, eating meals, and passing the time; later instructions locate it by waterside woods or after withdrawal from public teaching.
EvidenceBody: The witnesses connect the embryo with continued nourishment, maturation, and secluded residence after an initial attainment, preserving the gestational image.
